description: This file defines the Env class which provides static methods and getters to load and access environment variables for configuring the application. It handles loading variables from a .env file, with fallback defaults, and exposes specific configuration options like URLs, API endpoints, and mock mode settings.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class that manages loading and retrieving environment configuration variables for the app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the .env file, providing defaults and handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: authLoginPath
methods.description: Retrieves the login path for authentication, with a default fallback.

methods.name: mePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of endpoints for user profile API paths, based on an environment variable or defaults.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base API URL from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: realtimeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the WebSocket URL for real-time updates, with fallback default.

methods.name: eventsUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for event streaming, with fallback default.

methods.name: mockMode
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether mock mode is enabled, based on environment variable or default.
